name: Salem
scopeLimits: The ranked WUP point is a population-weighted Salem locator, not a parcel identity. Salem’s official Survey and Land Records department confirms computerized urban TSLR for Salem Corporation and online TSLR-copy services. Public correlation statements map old to current survey identifiers, but the reviewed material exposes no full polygon service. No parcel-number/owner lookup was submitted and no geometry was retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Salem District Administration confirms computerized Town Survey Land Records for Salem Corporation and provides official online TSLR extracts and current/old survey-identifier correlation records. This is local urban land-record evidence, not proof of ownership or an open polygon API.
technicalBlocker: The official e-services workflow is record-oriented (Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR extracts) and no public vector geometry API or map-service schema was discovered. Avoid submitting a property/survey lookup because returned records may include private landholding details.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the online TSLR service offers anonymous full geometry for a specific town survey block; coverage at the WUP point and citywide vector coverage are unverified.
nextStep: Locate an officially documented anonymous TSLR polygon service before attempting bounded geometry retrieval.
